title: Hardtack, Maggots, and Grog
hook: Sailors tapped their rock-hard ship biscuits in the dark.

scenes.text: After three months on the open Atlantic, fresh vegetables and meat were distant memories for pirate crews.

scenes.text: Daily rations revolved around 'hardtack': baked flour biscuits so rock-hard that sailors had to soak them in beer or broth to bite them.
scenes.imagePrompt: Wooden mess table with rock-hard square ship biscuits, a chipped ceramic bowl of grey pease porridge, and an iron spoon. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Daily rations revolved around 'hardtack': baked flour biscuits so rock-hard that sailors had to soak them in beer or broth to bite them.

scenes.text: Biscuits quickly infested with weevils and white maggots. Sailors ate their dinner in pitch darkness so they wouldn't see the bugs squirming.

scenes.voicedText: Biscuits quickly infested with weevils and white maggots. Sailors ate their dinner in pitch darkness so they wouldn't see the bugs squirming.

scenes.text: Without vitamin C, deadly scurvy struck: gums turned black and bled, teeth fell out, and old healed bone fractures mysteriously reopened.

scenes.text: Salted beef stored in brine barrels turned green and leathery. Sailors often carved tobacco pipes and belt buckles out of hard beef gristle.
